# Sample background

C57BL/6J male mice fed of 60 kcal% HFD (D12492, ResearchDiet) for various weeks from 8 weeks old. Plasma was collected with K2-EDTA at the sacrifice after HFD feeding for 0, 1 day, 3 days, 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, or 12 weeks: cohort number 7 ). Five samples out of 7-10 mice in each group were selected according to the body weight close to the median of each group except samples with lacking enough for the following assays, low hematocrit or cyst of kidney. MicroRNAs were analyzed by Takara (PR4436).

# Library

```{r library, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(ggplot2)

library(tidyverse)
library(ComplexHeatmap)

```

# 1. Data loading

```{r data loading, echo=TRUE}

data <- read.csv(file = "\\\\tsclient/H/Results/dataset/PR4436_miRNA-seq_cohort7/table/PR4436_expression.csv", header = T) %>% 
  as.data.frame()

# Extract TPM count matrix of mature miRNAs

head(data, n = 10)

datasheet <- read.csv(file = "\\\\tsclient/H/Results/dataset/PR4436_miRNA-seq_cohort7/datasheet/PR4436_datasheet.csv", header = T) %>% 
  as.data.frame()
```

# 2. QC

Remove transcripts that does not express at leaset three biological replicates in each category (weeks of HFD treatment).

## 2.1. Formatting data

```{r formatting, echo=TRUE}

# Formatting data
data <- column_to_rownames(data, var = "Transcript_ID")
data <- data[,3:52] 

data.t <- t(data) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "sample.ID")

data.t$sample.ID <- stringr::str_remove(basename(data.t$sample.ID),
                                         pattern = "_c\\.TPM$")

data.t <- left_join(x = data.t, y = list.sample, by = "sample.ID")
data.t$MouseID <- as.character(data.t$MouseID)

data.long <- data.t %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = where(is.numeric),  # all columns except sample.ID and Category
    names_to = "Transcript.ID",
    values_to = "TPM"
  )

head(data.long)

# Boxplot
ggplot(data.long, aes(x = sample.ID,
                       y = log10(1+TPM))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) +
  labs(title = "Expression distribution per sample",
       x = "Sample ID",
       y = "Log10(1+TPM)")
  
```

## 2.2. QC

```{r QC, echo=TRUE}

data.long_filtered <- data.long %>% 
  
  # group by Treatment AND Gene
  group_by(Treatment, Transcript.ID) %>%   
  
  # count how many samples > 10
  summarise(n_expressed = sum(TPM > 10), .groups = "drop") %>%  
  
  # keep if >= 5 samples in any Treatment group
  filter(n_expressed >= 5) %>%    
  
  # only keep gene names
  distinct(Transcript.ID)                   

data.clean <- data.long %>%
  filter(Transcript.ID %in% data.long_filtered$Transcript.ID)


# Boxplot
ggplot(data.clean, aes(x = sample.ID,
                       y = log10(1+TPM))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) +
  labs(title = "Expression distribution per sample after filteration",
       x = "Sample ID",
       y = "Log10(1+TPM)")


# Examples of expression changes across treatment conditions
p1 <- data.clean %>% 
  filter(Transcript.ID == "mmu-let-7a-1-3p") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Treatment, y = log2(1+TPM), fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  ylim(0, NA) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Expression of mmu-let-7a-1-3p",
       x = "Treatment",
       y = "log2(1+TPM)")

	
p2 <- data.clean %>% 
  filter(Transcript.ID == "mmu-miR-320-3p") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Treatment, y = log2(1+TPM), fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Expression of mmu-miR-320-3p",
       x = "Treatment",
       y = "log2(1+TPM)")

p1 + p2

```

```{r reformatting, echo=TRUE}
write.csv(data.clean_matrix,
```

# 3. Scaling

```{r scaling, echo=TRUE}

# Scaling
data.scaled <- data.clean %>% 
  group_by(Transcript.ID) %>% 
  mutate(scaled.tpm = as.vector(scale(x = TPM, 
                                      center = TRUE, 
                                      scale = TRUE))) %>% 
  arrange(sample.ID2)


summary <- data.scaled %>% 
  group_by(Transcript.ID) %>% 
  summarise(max = max(scaled.tpm),
            median = median(scaled.tpm),
            min = min(scaled.tpm))

data.scaled %>% 
  subset(Transcript.ID == c("mmu-miR-320-3p",
                            "mmu-let-7a-1-3p",
                            "mmu-miR-3968")) %>% 

ggplot(aes(x = scaled.tpm)) +
       geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.2, 
                      fill = "blue", 
                      alpha = 0.1, 
                      color = "black") +
       facet_wrap(~ Transcript.ID, scales = "free") +  # Separate histogram for each Assay
       theme_minimal() 
  
```

# 4. Heatmap

```{r heatmap, echo=TRUE}

## Format conversion to matrix
mat.scaled <- 
  data.scaled[,c("sample.ID2", "Transcript.ID", "scaled.tpm")] %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample.ID2,
              values_from = scaled.tpm) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "Transcript.ID") %>% 
  t()

samples <- rownames(mat.scaled)
timepoints <- sub("_.*","", samples) 
desired_order <- c("0d", "1d", "3d", "1wk", "2wk", "4wk", "6wk", "8wk", "10wk", "12wk")

time_factor <- factor(timepoints, levels = desired_order, ordered = TRUE)

mat.scaled_ordered <- 
  mat.scaled[order(time_factor, samples), , drop = FALSE]


column_category <- data.scaled[,c("sample.ID2", "Treatment")] %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "sample.ID2")

treatment_condition <- c("0d", 
                         "1d", 
                         "3d", 
                         "1wk", 
                         "2wk", 
                         "4wk", 
                         "6wk", 
                         "8wk", 
                         "10wk",
                         "12wk"
                         )

column_category$Treatment <- factor(column_category$Treatment,
                                    levels = treatment_condition)

category_colors <- structure(c("12wk" = "#000004FF",
                               "10wk" = "#180F3EFF",
                               "8wk" = "#451077FF",
                               "6wk" = "#721F81FF",
                               "4wk" = "#9F2F7FFF",
                               "2wk" = "#CD4071FF",
                               "1wk" = "#F1605DFF",
                               "3d" = "#FD9567FF",
                               "1d" = "#FEC98DFF",
                               "0d" = "#FCFDBFFF")) 

category_anno <- rowAnnotation(wks_HFD = column_category$Treatment, 
                               col = list(wks_HFD = category_colors)
                               )

heatmap <- Heatmap(mat.scaled,
            cluster_rows = FALSE,
            cluster_columns = hclust(dist(t(mat.scaled)), 
                                     method = "ward.D2"),
            column_split = 7,
            show_row_names = TRUE,
            row_split = column_category,
            left_annotation = category_anno,
            )

print(heatmap)

# Save output
wd <- getwd()
dir.output <- file.path(wd, "output")
if(!dir.exists(dir.output)){dir.create(dir.output)}

tiff(file.path(dir.output, "heatmap_miRNAs.tiff"),
     width = 16000,
     height = 4500,
     res = 300,
     compression = "lzw")
grid.newpage()
draw(heatmap)
dev.off()

svg(filename = file.path(dir.output, "heatmap.svg"),
     width = 16,
     height = 9)
grid.newpage()
draw(heatmap)
dev.off()


col_order_indices <- unlist(column_order(heatmap))
col_order_names <- colnames(scaled_mat)[col_order_indices]

```

# 5. Selected miRs

```{r}

list.selected <- read_csv("\\\\tsclient/H/Results/R_wd/DNB_cohort7/mirna/miRNAs_origin_PMID33772227.csv")
```

```{r}

match_mirna <- function(query, target) {
  result <- unlist(lapply(query, function(q) {
    if (grepl("[0-9][a-z]$", q)) {
      # Case 1: query ends with lowercase after number → exact match only
      matched <- target[grepl(paste0("^", q, "(-3p|-5p)?$"), target)]
    } else {
      # Case 2: base name → match all starting with it (allow suffix letter and strand)
      matched <- target[grepl(paste0("^", q, "[a-z]?(-3p|-5p)?$"), target)]
    }
    matched
  }))
  unique(result)
}

query <- rownames(binary_matrix)
query_clean <- gsub("^mmu-", "", query)

target <- gsub("^mmu-", "", colnames(mat.scaled))  # if needed

matched <- match_mirna(query_clean, target)
mat.scaled_subset <- mat.scaled[, colnames(mat.scaled) %in% paste0("mmu-", matched), drop = FALSE]


binary_matrix <- read_csv("\\\\tsclient/H/Results/R_wd/DNB_cohort7/mirna/bottom_anno_binary_mat.csv")
binary_matrix <- as.data.frame(binary_matrix) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("mirNa")

binary_named_fct <- binary_matrix
for (tissue in colnames(binary_named_fct)) {
  binary_named_fct[[tissue]] <- ifelse(binary_named_fct[[tissue]] == 1, tissue, NA)
}


binary_matrix_aligned <- binary_named_fct[colnames(mat.scaled_subset), , drop = FALSE]

all(rownames(binary_matrix_aligned) == colnames(mat.scaled_subset)) 

bottom_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df = binary_matrix_aligned,
  col = list(
    muscle = c("muscle" = "red"),
    `β-cells of pancreas` = c("β-cells of pancreas" = "blue"),
    liver = c("liver" = "green"),
    `adipose tissue` = c("adipose tissue" = "orange")
  ),
  na_col = "white",
  which = "column"
)



heatmap <- Heatmap(mat.scaled_subset,
            cluster_rows = FALSE,
            cluster_columns = hclust(dist(t(mat.scaled_subset)), 
                                     method = "ward.D2"),
            column_split = 7,
            show_row_names = FALSE,
            row_split = column_category,
            left_annotation = category_anno,
            bottom_annotation = bottom_anno
            )

plot(heatmap)

# Save output
wd <- getwd()
dir.output <- file.path(wd, "output")
if(!dir.exists(dir.output)){dir.create(dir.output)}

tiff(file.path(dir.output, "heatmap_selected_miRNAs.tiff"),
     width = 4000,
     height = 3000,
     res = 300,
     compression = "lzw")
grid.newpage()
draw(heatmap)
dev.off()
```
